parsed.rationale: Both `HLSAVPlayerProtocol` (in `Shared/Playback/Sources/HLSPlayer/Protocol/HLSAVPlayerProtocol.swift`) and `PlayerProtocol` (in `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Protocols/RadioPlayerProtocol.swift`) live in the same `Playback` package and share three identical members: `pause:()`, `play:()`, and `rate:Float`. `PlayerProtocol` is the more general abstraction (it also requires `replaceCurrentItem:(with item: AVPlayerItem?)`), while `HLSAVPlayerProtocol` is a specialisation that additionally requires `currentTime:() -> CMTime`, `seek:(to time: CMTime) async -> Bool`, and `seekableTimeRanges:[NSValue]`. Making `HLSAVPlayerProtocol` inherit from `PlayerProtocol` eliminates the three redundant declarations, enforces the correct layering (HLS-specific builds on top of the general player contract), and allows any code typed against `PlayerProtocol` to accept an HLS player without casting. Neither record carries any restraint flag (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so no intentional-duplication rule applies.
